title: eval-harness: add CI hook for prompt-set regression gating and integrate quality metrics
author: Priya Kannan
description: Motivation: Prevent prompt-set quality regressions from reaching production by adding a lightweight CI hook that runs a sampled eval of the changed prompt sets and compares quality metrics against a stored baseline. This PR introduces a gating step in PR CI that: 1) identifies changed prompt sets and associated test prompts, 2) runs a fast sampled evaluation (configurable sample size) using the eval-harness, 3) computes quality metrics (accuracy, exact match, BLEU-like score where applicable, and hallucination rate) and compares them to baseline thresholds stored in the repo, and 4) fails the gate when regressions exceed tolerances with a PR comment summarizing diffs and links to full artifact logs. Changes: - New CI workflow: .github/workflows/eval-prompt-regression.yml (runs on PRs, configurable sample size and timeout) - Eval harness additions: eval_harness/ci/hooks/prompt_regression.py (CI entrypoint, baseline comparator, results serializer) - Metrics aggregator: eval_harness/metrics/quality_metrics.py (metric computations and threshold checks) - Baseline storage: eval_harness/ci/baselines/README.md and a sample baseline JSON for the canonical prompt sets - PR comment helper: tools/pr_reporter/post_eval_result.py (posts summary and artifacts link) - Tests: tests/ci/test_prompt_regression_hook.py (unit + integration smoke) Rollout plan: Enabled for all PRs to redwood repo after merge; initial run is quick-sampled by default (sample_size=50) to keep CI latency ~3-6 minutes. A full nightly run is configured separately (ENG-1901). Backout: CI step is behind a single-line flag in workflow and can be disabled by maintainers; baseline JSONs are versioned so reverting is possible if thresholds are adjusted. Checklist: - [x] Add CI workflow and entrypoint - [x] Implement metric computations and comparator - [x] Add baseline example and docs - [x] Unit tests and integration smoke tests - [x] Post PR comment with results and artifacts link - [x] Add Linear tickets to PR description Testing performed: Local unit tests (pytest), CI smoke runs on feature branch, manual runs against production-like baseline for three representative prompt-sets. Observability: Results are written as artifacts and a condensed summary is posted to the PR. Full metric artifacts can be consumed by Redwood Console quality dashboards (follow-up integration via ENG-1901). Notes: This is an incremental change focused on gating prompt-set regressions; it intentionally samples to keep CI runtime low and integrates with nightly buckets for exhaustive runs.
